thread:
maria: Quick sync — final checklist for tomorrow's release. Need fast confirmations for owners on: version bump, changelog, QA smoke, security review, docs publish. I'm assigning tentative owners below; shout if you need swaps.

maria: Owners: version bump -> devon; changelog -> susan; QA smoke -> qa-bot (with manuel assist); security -> ryan; docs -> jen. Quiet window 09:00-11:00 UTC during cutover (no non-critical merges).

devon: I'm on the version bump. PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/2481 — will tag v1.4.0 after CI passes. WIll also add a note to the release metadata with migration instructions.

susan: Changelog scrub in progress. Found two entries that need clearer context (auth plugin and batching tweak). Pushed edits to PR 2490. Planning to merge once devon tags.

ryan: Security review: ran dependency-scan and SCA. One medium CVE in dev-deps (test-only) and two low findings; not release-blocking. I'll open tickets for the low ones and mark the medium as ignored with rationale in the ticket. Will add short security blurb for release notes.

jen: Docs: I'll publish the release notes page and the migration section. Waiting on the final changelog copy from susan. ETA 45m.

qa-bot: Smoke suite queued against staging. Command used: ```bash
./scripts/smoke-run.sh --env=staging --suite=release-smoke --parallel=4
```
qa-bot: Smoke results will post back here. If anything fails, tag @devon or @maria.

maria: Thanks — can each owner confirm they will be available for the quiet window and handoff? We need a couple of people to watch canary for the first 30m post-cut.

devon: I'll be on-call during the quiet window and can roll back the tag if necessary.

susan: I'll monitor changelog publishing and fix tiny copy issues live.

ryan: I'll watch the SCA dashboard and be ready to triage any infra-relevant security alerts.

jen: I'll be on docs duty for the first hour after cut.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 11:15 UTC -> 11:45 UTC. Canary targets: 10% traffic; fallback model variant configured.

maria: OK — final checklist before I mark this thread green: 1) devon merges tag -> v1.4.0, 2) susan merges changelog and posts release notes, 3) qa-bot completes smoke with green, 4) ryan posts security blurb, 5) jen publishes docs. Add thumbs-up here when done.

devon: Done — tag pushed and CI green. :thumbsup:

susan: Changelog merged and release notes draft posted: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/v1.4.0 — will tweak if anything crops up. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: Smoke suite: all tests passed (duration 7m). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2481/smoke

ryan: Security blurb posted in release notes and ticket links created for low findings: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-712

jen: Docs published and index updated. Redirects in place for old migration doc.

maria: Awesome — all green. I'll start the canary at 11:15 UTC. If anyone sees issues, post here and we'll execute rollback plan. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
